sources: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809), Symphony No. 94 in G 'Surprise', II. Andante — opening theme (original key C major); public domain
notes: First eight bars of the theme, in F major instead of C so the low notes stay at or above middle C (C4-F5; one B natural). Note values doubled from Haydn's 2/4 (eighths, quarter) to quarters and halves; the last note is held instead of followed by the loud chord. Written out from memory in the simplest form; no network in the build environment, so not compared against an online score. Needs a listen by a person.
